cues.text: Before she leaves, Maya checks the journey.
Traffic has built up on her usual road.
The map estimates thirty minutes that way, or twenty by another route.
Some navigation services use AI to combine traffic information with patterns from earlier journeys.
That helps them estimate how long a trip might take.
This is prediction: working out what may happen next.
Maya checks the route before setting off.
Twenty minutes is an estimate, though. Traffic can change.
